data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, small cap stocks.
data.investment_objective: The primary objective of the Scheme is to provide long-term capital appreciation / income by investing across market capitalisations and managing a diversified portfolio of Large Cap, Mid Cap and Small Cap Stock. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity & Equity related Instruments of Large, Mid and Small Cap Companies (including REITs) of which: Min -75% Max - 100% Large Cap Companies: Min -25% Max - 50% Mid Cap Companies Min -25% Max - 50% Small Cap Companies Min -25% Max - 50% Debt Securities and Money Market Instruments Min -0% Max - 25% Units issued by InvITs Min -0% Max - 10%
data.exit_load: 1.00% (of applicable NAV); if Units are redeemed/ switched-out within 1 month from the date of allotment., Nil thereafter
